notablePrerequisites: You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard that were put there this turn.
description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Garna.
When Garna enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning all creature cards that were put into your graveyard this turn to your hand.
Activate Skirge Familiar three times by discarding three creature cards, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
If you have four or more creature cards in your graveyard that were put there this turn, this combo nets infinite {B} and infinite blinking.
